    For losing weight with medical help: the two approved weekly shots, what they cost, and the copies sold online.

      Prescription; online clinics prescribe after a visit. Online clinics from $149/mo (Alloy).1

    • Tirzepatide (Zepbound)FDA approvedFrom $299/mo at online clinics · 2 clinics4

      Prescription. Online clinics from $299/mo (Alloy).4

      See plans at Alloy · $299/moOpens our clinic page
